senses.def: A village and civil parish in Rutland, England, north of Stamford (OS grid ref TF0310).
A village and civil parish in the Metropolitan Borough of Wakefield, West Yorkshire, England (OS grid ref SE3814).
A coastal village in the City of Sunderland, Tyne and Wear, England (OS grid ref NZ4152).
A suburb of Newcastle in the Lake Macquarie council area, New South Wales, Australia.
A transliteration of the Belarusian male given name Рыго́р (Ryhór).
